data.name: Jeewan
data.gender_notes: Jeewan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jeewan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Jiva’ which means ‘living being’ or ‘existence’. It is a powerful name that represents the essence of life and the eternal spirit within us. The name Jeewan carries the meaning “Lively, Living, Existence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jeewan usually hope their child will grow to embody lively, living, existence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine spark of life and the eternal soul within us.
data.etymology: Jeewan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lively, Living, Existence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeewan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

Jeewan is a reminder of our connection to the universe and our duty to live a life filled with love, purpose, and gratitude.
